# ak-ui tokens

Vendored token-only stylesheet from `@yunyoujun/ak-ui` **1.1.0**, under the accompanying MIT license.

- Upstream: https://github.com/YunYouJun/ak-ui
- Package: https://registry.npmjs.org/@yunyoujun/ak-ui/-/ak-ui-1.1.0.tgz
- Archive SHA-1: `f8dc7cf5421da1367838859f84df542609c322a6`
- Source file: `package/dist/tokens.css`, unmodified.

Only the JackalClient layout loads these tokens. Its scoped dark brand mapping and native components live in `layouts/_default/jackalclient.html`. No runtime CDN, framework, global component reset, or package-manager build step is required.
